sections.title: MSSP Capstone Seminar: Policy Communications
sections.description: The focus of the Capstone Seminar is three-fold: 1) to enhance student integration of the theory and practice of social policy analysis; 2) to enhance the student's competencies in the written and oral communication processes and procedures necessary for the policy world; and 3) to ensure basic knowledge about federal budget processes, stakeholder roles, and inter-organizational collaboration. At the end of this course, students will complete a final project related to their policy internship. Registration restricted to majors only.
